correctness.rationale: The difference Gram matrix is explicitly 6,-4,1; deleting one internal coefficient leaves two blocks joined by a single entry. Fourth-difference quartic and cubic identities yield all Green bulk and edge data. Total nonnegativity of the sign-conjugated Gram matrix and a strictly positive Cauchy--Binet cofactor term establish strict inverse positivity. The exact Schur complement and phase-wise Cauchy--Schwarz prove the constant and all equality cases. Exact-rational tests cover small block sizes but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The novel and natural constraint is one missing Fourier coefficient inside a contiguous frequency block. It creates a nontrivial rank-one coupling of two Green problems, changes the sharp constant and forces opposite phases on both sides of the missing frequency. The formula and all equality cases are uniform over two independent block lengths and provide a structural sparse-spectrum analogue of the motivating unconstrained sharp inequality.
